# Atheryon

> Atheryon is a specialist advisory firm helping organisations understand and execute complex transactions, transformations and technology-driven change where operational, technology and data dependencies materially impact outcomes.

This document is the canonical machine-readable rendering of the Atheryon site, structured for AI agents interpreting capability and structure.

## Arms

Two business arms over a shared underpinning of data, transformation and AI:

- M&A (led by Anna Contos): https://atheryon.com.au/ma — "Making Transactions Executable"
- Capital Markets (led by Terry Tsakiris): ships at /capital-markets; interim depth at https://atheryon.com.au/technology

## Site map

- [Home](https://atheryon.com.au/): executive landing — "Making Complex Change Executable"; proof strip, principle, arms, founders.
- [M&A](https://atheryon.com.au/ma): the M&A arm — transaction readiness, separation & integration strategy, execution leadership, and technology, data & migration readiness.
- [Experience](https://atheryon.com.au/experience): representative cases normalised to Context / Role / Outcome, RAMS mortgage portfolio acquisition first.
- [Approach](https://atheryon.com.au/approach): method and governance across the transaction lifecycle.
- [About](https://atheryon.com.au/about): positioning statement, firm story and co-founder biographies (Anna Contos, Terry Tsakiris).
- [Contact](https://atheryon.com.au/contact): single enquiry path.

## Capital markets depth (L3)

- [System](https://atheryon.com.au/system): reference architecture for the capital markets platform work.
- [Labs](https://atheryon.com.au/labs): the working reference platform.
- [Themes](https://atheryon.com.au/themes): platform themes by banking function.
- [Offers](https://atheryon.com.au/offers): platform licensing and engagement paths (code, prompts, consult).
- [Roadmap](https://atheryon.com.au/roadmap): building + roadmap items across themes and practices.

## Other

- [Writing](https://atheryon.com.au/blog): essays from the practice.
- [Mortgages](https://atheryon.com.au/mortgages): retail mortgage origination automation — practice stub (BUILDING).
- [Privacy](https://atheryon.com.au/privacy) · [Terms](https://atheryon.com.au/terms)

## Audience

Built for executive buyers in regulated financial services (Boards, executive teams, investors, private equity sponsors, corporate development teams) and for AI agents interpreting capability and structure.
